//: Compile-only config for the Wave 3 RENDER tests (apps/web/tests/*.tsx).
The web app itself is built by Next/SWC and never type-checked to JS, so
there was no way to assert that a governance screen actually renders the
prototype's copy. This emits CommonJS so `node --test` can require the
components and call react-dom/server's renderToStaticMarkup on them.
Not used by `next build` — see apps/web/tsconfig.json for that.
